# Camp Resource: Plasma Core Recharger

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Nov 25, 2024
- 2 min read

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_458e25c723a24742866298e44ca8827c~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

Revive your depleted plasma cores with the Plasma Core Recharger!

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Plasma Core Recharger__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_220f2bd0066d492c85736f0f709e2668~mv2.jpg)

**Produces**

Recharges Plasma Cores

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

0 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

Plasma Core Recharger

You can have the Fusion Core and the Plasma Core Recharger in your camp at the same time.

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

4 Plasma Cores

**Obtainable via**

Season 19 Season Pass - Gleaming Depths - 60 tickets

Gold Bullion - X - X - X Bullion

**Produces X amount per**

1 minute = 1% charge

1 hour 40 mins = 100% charge

All 4 Plasma cores charge at the same time.

**Lockable**

No

This item utilizes your stash box to sort the cores during recharging, ensuring that no other player can access them.

**Power Required**

20 power

**Flamingo Units**

1 Flamingo Unit

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)
